summary: Supplier Catalog Import™ MVP — full backend + frontend testing. 10/10 backend tests passed (taxonomy, create, upload-PDF-extract, GET catalog, PATCH candidates, finalize, archive product filter, archive editorial+brand filter, list catalogs, delete soft-archive). 7/7 frontend wizard + UI assertions passed (CTA button, type-toggle with 3 pills, modal with 4-step stepper, step1 6 fields with disable→enable on brand, step2 dropzone copy, drawer ProductInfoBlock with brand/collezione/categoria/diritti, ZERO forbidden AI/OCR/parser/model words in DOM).
critical_code_review_comments: supplier_catalogs.py uses `image_ext or 'png'` content-type mapping (line 245) — works but `image/jpg` is non-standard; PIL produces 'jpeg'. Confirm extractor returns 'jpeg' not 'jpg' to avoid odd mime types — minor.

finalize_catalog idempotency relies on cand.media_id but the field is reset only via re-finalize; if a candidate insert fails mid-loop, retries will re-insert all preceding ones. Consider an upsert-by-(catalog_id,page_number) media_library check.

Inspiration cards lack a unique data-testid like `ins-card-{id}`. Only `ins-card-product-badge` is on the badge — makes deterministic card targeting in tests verbose. Adding a `data-testid="ins-card-{id}"` on the card root would improve testability.
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 fresh 'Bonaldo' catalog with full PDF upload + finalize (57 Product Inspirations imported, archived at end of test, products remain live). Also 1 lightweight 'TestBrand' draft catalog (no PDF). Both are visible in /api/inspirations/catalogs list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_81_supplier_catalog.py -v (40s, requires /tmp/bonaldo.pdf). Frontend: card click must target parent of [data-testid='ins-card-product-badge'] since the card root has no dedicated testid. Existing Bonaldo catalogs from manual + this run accumulate in the tenant — archive endpoint is soft, never deletes media_library rows.
rca of the issue: N/A — all flows passed end-to-end including PDF extraction (113 pages → 61 candidates, ~57 named), candidate image upload to cms-assets (public URL reachable HTTP 200), candidate edit persistence, finalize → media_library inserts, archive filter inspiration_type=product/editorial + case-insensitive brand filter, soft archive preserves imported products.
